UP ONE, AND THE JUDGEMENT IS THE POINT RATHER THAN THE NUMBER. The gate is a count of auto_install bridges under 60 pyLOC, and its own docstring says a fold is a decision per module taken by reading the list, with the floor as where that decision is recorded.

The new entry is documents_speech, 18 pyLOC over documents and speech. It stays a bridge because there is nowhere to fold it: into documents makes documents depend on speech, into speech makes speech depend on documents, and both are inversions of a dependency that must not exist. That is the same shape the docstring already exempts for an OPL-1 dependency kept out of an LGPL-3 parent.
